experience.title: Work Experience

highlights: Led zero-downtime modernization of mission-critical services from .NET Framework on AWS EC2 (Windows) to containerized .NET on AWS EKS, eliminating 5+ years of technical debt with zero customer impact.

Architected an event-driven Order Orchestration Engine using AWS EventBridge, SNS, and SQS to automate Salesforce order ingestion — eliminating manual steps from the sales pipeline and accelerating order processing.
Built a reusable .NET HTTP resilience library with IHttpClientFactory, automated OAuth2 token lifecycle, and configurable circuit breakers/retries — adopted across multiple squads.

Integrated Claude Code & GitHub Copilot into the full SDLC (architecture, coding, test generation, code review), measurably increasing team throughput sprint-over-sprint. Established AI tooling best practices later adopted across the organization.
Migrated legacy React/.NET Framework internal tools to Retool (no-code), freeing engineering capacity from internal CRUD maintenance to focus on core revenue-generating products.
Introduced end-to-end automated testing with Playwright in the build pipeline, validating critical frontend and backend user journeys on every deployment.

Engineered a standardized Server-Driven UI (SDUI) framework for Editorial and Reviews pages, establishing a unified contract across Web, iOS, and Android — decoupling cross-team dependencies and reducing time-to-market.
Decomposed a monolithic Editorial API into separate read/write paths with Redis distributed caching (CQRS), improving scalability for consuming teams.
Led the Redbook.com.au frontend rewrite in React/TypeScript, driving a 20% traffic increase to inquiry pages.
Shipped "Can't Find Your Car" feature end-to-end, generating 200+ new ad listings within 90 days of launch.
Designed SOC2-compliant public APIs with ASP.NET Core and OAuth2/JWT for third-party loan submissions in a regulated fintech environment.
Built .NET Framework ASP.NET MVC applications for loan product landing pages with responsive Razor views and form submission pipelines.
Led the MoneyMe+ WooCommerce plugin team; integration brought in 1,000+ e-commerce leads within its first 60 days.
Led a cross-functional squad of 10 with full ownership of sprint grooming, technical specs, weekly releases, and on-call rotation.
Optimized lender API integration layer, reducing response times from 8s to 2s on a platform processing 150,000 transactions per day.
